name: Enchanted Garden
author: Addicting Games
description: Enchanted Garden is a puzzle game where you must find all of the hidden objects in a garden. Enter into a magical garden that is full of beautiful flowers and other exotic plants. Find flowers, numbers, plants, mushrooms, and keys among the majestic background. There are 3 levels for this online game but don’t let that fool you into thinking this is a quick game. Each game has a limited amount of turns and you must complete categories to gain more turns. If you get stuck, use the zoom feature to find objects that are cleverly hidden. Some items may be a different color, transparent, or just extremely small. Do not leave any stone unturned in this hidden object game. You are not punished for clicking items not on your list, but items in another category do take up a turn. Select the High Scores tab to see where you rank against other puzzle players!
